crossRefs.note: The heavens declare the glory of God. The expanse shows his handiwork.
Yahweh’s works are great, pondered by all those who delight in them.
“Isn’t God in the heights of heaven? See the height of the stars, how high they are!
“Remember that you magnify his work, about which men have sung.
For the invisible things of him since the creation of the world are clearly seen, being perceived through the things…
By Yahweh’s word, the heavens were made: all their army by the breath of his mouth.
In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.
Then the magicians said to Pharaoh, “This is God’s finger;” but Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he didn’t listen to…
When he finished speaking with him on Mount Sinai, he gave Moses the two tablets of the covenant, stone tablets…
But if I by God’s finger cast out demons, then God’s Kingdom has come to you.
He appointed the moon for seasons. The sun knows when to set.
to him who made the great lights; for his loving kindness endures forever:
Praise him, sun and moon! Praise him, all you shining stars!
God made the two great lights: the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night. He also made…
and lest you lift up your eyes to the sky, and when you see the sun and the moon and the stars, even all the army of…
Can his armies be counted? On whom does his light not arise?
Behold, even the moon has no brightness, and the stars are not pure in his sight;

translations.web: When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have ordained;
translations.bsb: When I behold Your heavens, the work of Your fingers, the moon and the stars, which You have set in place—
translations.kjv: When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, the moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained;
translations.asv: When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, The moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained;
